title: Faster Automated Pipelines to Utilize Volume Electron Microscopy in Biomedical Testing
content: Volume Electron Microscopy (vEM) encompasses several EM technologies, including serial block-face scanning EM (SBEM), FIBSEM, and array tomography. Information-rich image sets generated by vEM systems provide a wealth of data from which to compare therapeutic treatments and investigate mechanisms of disease. Timelines for collecting and manually analyzing 3D EM datasets can extend from weeks to years, however, and may reduce the utility of vEM approaches preclinical testing environments.
